tables.caption: Three routes to a new PostgreSQL major version
tables.text:
Three routes to a new PostgreSQL major version
Route	What moves	Where the cost and responsibility sit
Dump and restore	Logical object definitions and data	Rebuild data and indexes; include roles and other globals; close the final source history.
pg_upgrade	New catalogues with compatible existing user data files	A stopped final transfer, compatible binaries/modules and the chosen copy/link/clone behaviour.
Logical replication migration	Initial selected rows followed by ongoing changes	Two live environments, compatible schemas, stream retention and final catch-up; move unreplicated state separately.
